grid.note: 576 pre-declared variants: timeframe 1/5/15m × setups × stop 1/2 ATR × reward 1/2 × hold 10/40 bars × taker/maker × cost-edge filter off/3× × cooldown 0/10 bars

caveats: Candle-level simulation: no order-book queue position; maker fills require price to trade through the limit and same-candle stops are assumed hit first.
Historical bid/ask spread is not available for these dates (Binance bookTicker archive returned 404), so no spread filter can be evaluated; spread is a fixed assumption.
Fees are list-price assumptions, not account-verified; VIP tiers and BNB discounts are not modelled.
576 variants were searched; the best selection-window result is biased upward by multiple testing, which is why only unseen test windows count.
Factor tables are descriptive over the whole period and were NOT used for selection.

makerAdverseSelection.note: Markout = direction-adjusted move from the fill to the close 5 candles later, in basis points (before costs).

fullPeriodPositiveVariants.note: In-sample over the WHOLE period (includes test windows) — shown only to illustrate selection bias; never used.
